No mention in IMPROVEMENTS.md or final_message that old accuracy (13/14) is incomparable because the label set changed. The eval compares the new prompt in isolation without baseline before/after comparison.
No mention that 20 cases or the 6 refund cases are insufficient sample size to claim 100% accuracy is meaningful, nor proposal for more cases or repeated runs.
